prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, a 12-cell grid body (6 rows, two columns), every cell a genuinely different material, every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in age-gyaru makeup — luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, towering teased bleached-blonde hair, a confident sparkling expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large gold chandelier-shaped hoop.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply, then an enormous belly and colossal wide hips flaring out again, body divided into a 12-cell grid (6 rows, two columns), each cell a different material, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 12 cells — 6 horizontal rows crossed by one vertical centre line — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell clear turquoise water with drifting bubbles; right cell clear rose-pink water with drifting rose petals. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars; right cell clear emerald-green water with drifting water lilies. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell clear amethyst-violet water with soft drifting moonbeams; right cell clear citrine-gold water with drifting fireflies. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell clear ice-blue water with drifting snowflakes; right cell clear coral-pink water with drifting light. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell clear periwinkle-blue water with drifting feathers; right cell clear topaz-gold water with drifting light. Row 6 (left thigh-stub tip / right thigh-stub tip (a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be)): left cell solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal, rounding off at its tip; right cell solid transparent deep blue sapphire crystal, rounding off at its tip.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep indigo on one side and a warm amber on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so indigo light glances off one side and amber light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
